basic_profile.bio: Avid reader and drum enthusiast living in Portland, Oregon. I have a penchant for exploring the depths of literature, especially those books that are so bad they're good. When I'm not indulging in questionable literary choices, you can find me jamming on my drum set or tinkering with my space bucket setup. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to dive into my hobbies. Single, with a cat named Riff, I typically browse Reddit late at night after a long day of work and music practice.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in English Literature, which has equipped me with a critical eye for narrative and style. My interest in drumming is self-taught, fueled by countless hours of online tutorials and practice sessions. I stumbled upon the concept of space buckets during a Reddit browsing session, which has since become a fascinating hobby.
